name: Sturdy
description: The Pokemon is not knocked out from full HP by a one-hit KO move or a move that would leave it with 0 HP.

name: Flash Fire
description: Powers up the Pokemon's Fire-type moves if it's hit by one.

name: Intimidate
description: Lowers the opposing Pokemon's Attack stat when entering battle.

name: Inner Focus
description: The Pokemon is protected from flinching.

name: Sand Stream
description: The Pokemon summons a sandstorm that lasts 5 turns when it enters battle.

name: Cute Charm
description: Contact with the Pokemon may cause infatuation.

name: Shed Skin
description: The Pokemon may heal its own status conditions by shedding its skin.

name: Rock Head
description: Protects the Pokemon from recoil damage.

name: Heavy Metal
description: Doubles the Pokemon's weight.

name: Multiscale
description: Reduces damage the Pokemon takes when its HP is full.

name: Justified
description: Being hit by a Dark-type move boosts the Attack stat of the Pokemon, for justice.

name: Pixilate
description: Normal-type moves become Fairy-type and deal 20% more damage.

name: Sand Spit
description: The Pokemon creates a sandstorm when it's hit by an attack.

name: Coil
description: Raises Attack, Defense, and Accuracy.

name: Sand Veil
description: Boosts the Pokemon's evasiveness in a sandstorm.

name: Prankster
description: Gives priority to status moves.

name: Berserk
description: Boosts Sp. Atk by 1 when HP drops to half or below.

name: Drought
description: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokemon enters a battle.

name: Snow Cloak
description: Boosts evasiveness in a hailstorm or snowstorm.

name: Snow Warning
description: The Pokemon summons a snowstorm when it enters a battle.

name: Anger Point
description: Maxes out the Attack stat after the Pokemon takes a critical hit.

name: Sheer Force
description: Removes additional effects of moves to increase their power.

name: Cud Chew
description: When the Pokemon eats a Berry, it will eat the same Berry again at the end of the next turn.

name: Overgrow
description: Powers up Grass-type moves when the Pokemon's HP is low.

name: Long Reach
description: The Pokemon uses moves without making contact with the target.

name: Weak Armor
description: Physical attacks lower Defense but sharply raise Speed.

name: Synchronize
description: Passes a burn, poison, or paralysis to the Pokemon that inflicted it.

name: Trace
description: The Pokemon copies the Ability of a foe it faces in battle.

name: Iron Fist
description: Powers up punching moves.

name: No Guard
description: Ensures attacks by or against the Pokemon land.

name: Klutz
description: The Pokemon cannot use its held item, but still suffers from negative effects.

name: Blaze
description: Powers up Fire-type moves when the Pokemon's HP is low.

name: Torrent
description: Powers up Water-type moves when the Pokemon's HP is low.
